output.reason: The cited excerpt on its own is just a metric name. However, the section it belongs to explains the change [ev-1f419676f177]. Metrics that started with `cortex_` are renamed in 3.0.0 to start with `loki_`, because the default `metrics_namespace` is now `loki`. Operators who set `metrics_namespace` to `cortex` keep the old prefix, and that setting is already deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. This gives the subject (metric `cortex_kv_request_duration_seconds_sum` [ev-9eb382b7f994]), the change (a rename to the `loki_` prefix), who is exposed (anyone who has not set `metrics_namespace: cortex`) and the consequence (the metric is no longer published under its old name, so anything that queries the old name stops matching).
